svg.title: OPENAI_API_KEY, value hidden
svg.desc: EnvCloak redaction moment. OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-demo-xxxx types in one character every 55 ms, then the value collapses into the block (3185 to 3785 ms), which blinks twice and rests at 5905 ms. The value is a fake demo string. Reduced motion shows the resting line OPENAI_API_KEY=█.
